name: policy_authorization
invariants: Evaluation requires an authenticated principal from Authentication Boundary v1.
The principal tenant, request tenant, and published policy-context tenant scope must agree before evaluation.
Policy context and the request must carry the same config_version.
Only an allow outcome may enter the router boundary.
Deny and indeterminate outcomes use structured reason_code values and never rely on free-text logs.
Policy source, Prompt or Response bodies, Provider credentials, and internal endpoints never appear in decisions.
The online Data Plane evaluation path never queries Control Plane PostgreSQL.
Usage, Billing, Audit, and Analytics persistence never blocks the decision path.

indeterminate_handling.rule: Indeterminate is never silently converted to allow or deny inside this interface.
